name: Upplandsleden, etapp 11, Gimo-Österbybruk
description: Upplandsleden section 11: Gimo / Gimo herrgård to Österbybruk / Österbybruks bruksmiljö.

facilities.name: Rastplats, Sågarbo
facilities.description: Official rest area at Sågarbo with ruins, old sawmill traces and a simple fireplace. Naturkartan categorizes the marker as Rastplats; no separate fireplace/grillplats marker was found, so do not add a separate fireplace row unless importer needs a split service row.

facilities.name: Vindskydd, Glamsmossen
facilities.description: Official shelter near Glamsmossen. Use Naturkartan coordinate as authoritative; OSM shelter geometry was noted as nearby but not identical.

facilities.name: Eldplats, Glamsmossen
facilities.description: Fireplace/grill function associated with the official Glamsmossen shelter area. Naturkartan notes that visitors should bring their own wood or charcoal; no wood is supplied from 2023. Same-coordinate service clustering should be handled during import.

facilities.name: Rastplats, Glamsmossen
facilities.description: Rest function associated with the official Glamsmossen shelter marker. Import only if the app clusters this same-coordinate service with the shelter/fireplace; otherwise fold into the shelter row.

facilities.name: Aspbo östra badplats
facilities.description: Official Aspbo/Stordammen swimming area on the Etapp 11 corridor.

facilities.name: Grillplats, Aspbo östra
facilities.description: Official/corroborated grill place at the eastern Aspbo/Stordammen swimming area.

facilities.name: Toalett, Aspbo östra
facilities.description: Official/corroborated toilet at the eastern Aspbo/Stordammen area.

facilities.name: Tältplats, Aspbo
facilities.description: Official tenting option in Aspbo nature reserve. Distinct from Glamsmossen, where official material says the ground is poor for tents.

facilities.name: Aspbo västra badplats
facilities.description: Western Aspbo/Stordammen swimming area on the Etapp 11 corridor.

facilities.name: Grillplats, Aspbo västra
facilities.description: Western Aspbo/Stordammen grill place. Keep proximity visible because it is farther from the main GPX than the eastern facility cluster.

facilities.name: Toalett, Aspbo västra
facilities.description: Western Aspbo/Stordammen toilet. Later iterations should verify if seasonal or year-round details are available.

facilities.name: Toalett, Österbybruk
facilities.description: Dedicated Naturkartan marker found: public toilet at torget, open year-round 07-21. Municipality also confirms a separate 24h RWC at the bus waiting hall, but no distinct Naturkartan coordinate was found for that in iteration 2.

facilities.name: Vatten, Österbybruk
facilities.description: Dedicated Naturkartan marker found: municipal water tap outside the laundry, on year-round.

facilities.name: Vallonsmedjan i Österbybruk
facilities.description: Official endpoint heritage POI. Naturkartan describes the preserved Walloon forge, with additional visitor/culture context from Österbybruk Herrgård.

facilities.name: Folkmora ruins
facilities.description: Official route text confirms that Etapp 11 passes the ruins of the large Folkmora farm. Coordinate is OSM-derived from the southern/farm ruins geometry; a second ruins polygon sits about 40 m northwest. Not an official POI coordinate, so confidence remains medium.

facilities.name: RWC, Österbybruk busstation
facilities.description: Östhammar municipality lists Österbybruk Bussväntsalen as 1 RWC open 24h. Coordinate is placed on the Österbybruk busstation cluster, corroborated by the Naturkartan busstation marker and distinct from the torget toilet about 205 m away, which is open 07-21.
